component.name: Realm Portal
component.summary: Switch between game realms with one click

description.p: Realm Portal is a desktop launcher for private game servers. You add the servers you want and point the app to your own game client; Realm Portal then switches the client to the realm you pick, with a single click.
The app does not download or distribute game clients or game content. The interface is available in English and Spanish.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment.
